observation: A newly created disposable private world loaded UCustomZoneRegistry. Its default global DamageChannelsVsHandlingMethod array was inspected without mutation. Native encoder/decoder and enumerations were inspected read-only. The observation process was explicitly reclaimed after readback; normal shutdown, client joins and combat effects were not validated.
tests_scope: Five synthetic schema-73 SQLite regressions cover three-slot updates, unrelated world/unknown-bit retention, WAL-only data in the pre-change backup, stale/replaced/readonly/corrupt/unknown-layout rejection and no-op writes. A separate real native world copy passed the public stopped-instance read/write API, exact executable gate, committed reload and pre-change backup readback; original DB/WAL bytes stayed unchanged. Backups omit only the reconstructable SCUM.db-shm index and retain the main database, WAL and unrelated sidecars. No user database was used; client combat and a new SCUM server lifecycle were not assessed.

native_database_roundtrip.source: Previously created disposable schema-73 native world; original main database and WAL preserved byte-for-byte
